review.gallery: Nine native project renders extracted from Ellington’s brochure, including a full tower view used on listing cards.
review.location: Official map marks The Highgrove by the lagoon. Dubainary site point is within nine metres of the separate Terra Firma listing point. Ellington’s main project page and microsite differ for the sanctuary, Burj Khalifa/Dubai Mall and DXB. Both estimates are reflected in the ranges. Proposed Metro travel time is omitted from current destinations.
review.floorPlans: Forty complete floor plan PDF pages and eight official amenities sheets reviewed, with printed unit types and areas checked visually. Separate amenities sheets show the ground and fourth floors where the main floor plans start on the fifth.

unavailable: Confirmed visitor entrance and current Metro access, standalone basement or podium Levels 1–3 drawings, and contracted unit-specific area schedules.
